thesis.note: Grafiati labels the record 'Full text' but points to the legacy EThOS OrderDetails URL; that legacy URL currently fails to retrieve in the checked path. The restored EThOS platform is metadata/discovery-first and only links to university full text when a repository copy exists.

manuscript.title: Trellis complexity using the first and last bases

evidence: R. A. Bailey's maintained PhD-student page lists Costas Papadopoulos: Codes and trellises.
British Combinatorial Bulletin 1999 lists Costas Papadopoulos as Prof. Bailey/Prof. Cameron; trellis decoding.
Therefore both Bailey and Cameron are direct scholarly/archive routes.
supervision_provenance.correction_to_v6: Do not describe Cameron as the sole supervisory route.

institutional_access_facts: Queen Mary Library holds print theses awarded 1910-2012 and asks researchers to submit author/title/year through its Thesis Request Form.
Queen Mary Archives answers remote enquiries by email and can perform up to about half an hour of research; remote digital copies may be ordered where feasible.

British Library EThOS was restored in 2026 as a discovery/metadata platform. It does not itself host the restored full-text corpus; when no university-repository link exists, researchers are told to contact the university.
British Library states that some print-only theses may still be digitised at the awarding university's discretion through the EThOS digitisation workflow.

ordered_acquisition_plan.request: Confirm the exact holdings/access status of thesis uk.bl.ethos.325031 and ask whether a digital copy already exists but is not publicly linked; if not, ask whether digitisation for QMRO/EThOS can be initiated for an international researcher unable to visit.

Search catalogue/draft uncatalogued lists/appropriate personal or departmental holdings for the Bailey-Cameron-Papadopoulos manuscript, thesis working papers, correspondence, seminar notes or drafts around 'Trellis complexity using the first and last bases'.

Ask only whether she retains or recognizes a copy/title history of the in-preparation manuscript or the thesis, and whether the work contained an optimization over repeated/parallel generator-column classes via three endpoint states or an equivalent distinct-class DP.
Ask the same narrow archival/bibliographic question, specifically whether the in-preparation manuscript was ever circulated, deposited, retitled, or absorbed into another publication.

predecessor_if_any_of: Coordinates/generator columns are partitioned into repeated/parallel equivalence classes and coordinate-order optimization is performed over per-class states equivalent to NOT_STARTED / ACTIVE / FINISHED.
An exact product state space equivalent to 2^s*3^r is constructed for singleton/repeated classes.
An exact endpoint transition graph equivalent to A3's transition graph is constructed.
An exact algorithm equivalent to O(k*3^k) (up to ordinary polynomial factors/preprocessing) is given where k is the number of distinct column/geometric classes.
A more general theorem is stated from which the full A3 endpoint quotient and algorithm follow as a direct definitional corollary.
not_a_kill_if_only: first/last bases for a fixed coordinate order
recognition that repeated generator columns exist
generic coordinate permutation heuristics without class-product quotient

decision_table.ACTUAL_PREDECESSOR_FOUND: Downgrade/remove A3 novelty claim; cite predecessor; preserve theorem correctness if still independently valid.
decision_table.THESIS_AND_MANUSCRIPT_OBTAINED_NO_PREDEC: Close Papadopoulos archival gap; keep N3 and move to external expert review/clean-room replication; do not auto-promote N4.
decision_table.THESIS_OBTAINED_MANUSCRIPT_NOT_FOUND: Reduce but do not close archival gap.
decision_table.EXPERT_CONFIRMS_MANUSCRIPT_NEVER_CONTAIN: Strong bibliographic evidence; still not universal absence.
decision_table.NO_RESPONSE_OR_ACCESS_DENIED: ARCHIVAL_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; keep N3 ceiling and record unresolved risk.

no_redundant_work: Do not run additional broad web searches for Papadopoulos/Bailey/Cameron unless a newly discovered citation, title variant, archive identifier, or expert response supplies a concrete new lead.
